title: Loop Kit configuration
description: The single point of per-repo configuration for the Loop Kit. Nothing in the kit is hardcoded; every per-repo decision lives here.

$schema.description: Optional path or URL to this schema.

requiredChecks.description: The name(s) of the CI status check(s) that form the green-gate. The gate requires ALL of these to have concluded success for the exact head SHA. Must be non-empty: a gate with no required checks would let everything through.

dangerousEdges.description: Glob patterns for files whose modification makes a job human-gated. A job that touches any of these must be approved by a human before it ships.

branchPrefix.description: Prefix for branches the runner creates, e.g. 'claude/'.

notify.description: One-way ping configuration for when the runner stops.

channel.description: Where to send the stop ping. 'none' disables notification.

target.description: Channel-specific target: a file path (file), a URL (webhook), or a shell command template (command). Ignored for 'none'.

mergeMode.description: What the runner does after a green PR. 'auto-merge-on-green' squash-merges once the gate is green; 'tee-up' builds and leaves the PR for a human.

astra.description: Claude Code to Codex worker bridge. Defaults pin GPT-6 Astra in a workspace-write sandbox.

enabled.description: Whether Claude may delegate bounded tasks through the Astra bridge.

command.description: Codex CLI executable name or absolute path.

model.description: Exact Codex worker model. The public TrustOS claim is reproducible with gpt-6-astra.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort passed to Codex for delegated work.

sandbox.description: Maximum sandbox used for build delegations. Plan and review are always read-only.

decisions.description: The two-way async decision surface. The loop can ask a yes/no question (approve a proposed job, or give a go-ahead on a human-gated one) and act on your reply on its next run. An approval never bypasses the merge-time human gate.

inbox.description: Optional file the kit reads one-line replies from on its next run, one per line as '<decision-id> <answer>'. Omit it to answer only via the 'loop-decisions answer' command (or by editing the ledger).

migrations.description: Migration discipline configuration. Omit if the repo has no migrations.

dir.description: Directory holding migration files, relative to the repo root.

numberWidth.description: Zero-padded width of the central migration number prefix, e.g. 4 for 0001_*.

scout.description: The scout: a read-only job-proposer that scans the repo and adds ranked, diff-checkable jobs to the queue as 'proposed'. Every field is optional; omitted fields use the scout's built-in defaults.

maxProposals.description: Maximum jobs the scout proposes per scan.

checks.description: Each scan check, toggleable. The two site checks default off; the rest default on.

emDash.description: Flag em-dash characters (the kit forbids them).

todoMarkers.description: Flag leftover TODO/FIXME markers in code.

testsForSources.description: Flag source files with no matching test.

brokenInternalLinks.description: Flag internal links that resolve to nothing. For repos that build a site.

missingMetaDescription.description: Flag HTML pages with no meta description. For repos that build a site.

include.description: Glob patterns for files to scan. Default: everything.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to skip (node_modules, build output, lockfiles, and so on).

maxAssetBytes.description: A committed file larger than this (bytes) is flagged as an oversized asset.

sourceExtensions.description: Extensions treated as source for the tests-for-sources check.

commentScanExtensions.description: Extensions scanned for TODO/FIXME markers (documentation is excluded by default).

siteDir.description: When set, the site checks are scoped to this directory and '/'-rooted links resolve under it.
